declarations.name: AuiTagGroup
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI TagGroup: `<aui-tag-group>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor; `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Tags: { value, label, disabled? } (unique values, at most 1,000).

inputs.name: removable
inputs.description: Remove button per tag; Delete and Backspace remove the focused tag.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the remove label and announcement.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the selection (or removed a selected tag): { value }.

outputs.name: removed
outputs.description: The user removes a tag: { value, item }. Prevent it to keep the tag.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the tag in the tab sequence.

accessibility.pattern: Grid list (as in the React Aria TagGroup): role=grid with one row per tag and one gridcell per row; roving tabindex over the rows.

limitations: Removing the last tag leaves focus on the page body; move focus to a sensible control in an aui-remove handler.
Every change re-creates the tag elements (focus is restored to the same tag).
